title: First sorting boundary on module sheaves
statement: Let f': X' -> T' be a scheme morphism, M an O_X'-module, r a natural number, W0: ULift(Fin r) -> Opens(X'), and D a natural-degree cochain complex of O_X'-modules. Let e identify its additive presheaves with the full Cech presentation, satisfying differential compatibility hd and local scalar compatibility hlinear as in [def-pc-ordered-cech-module-coordinates]. Write L for the pushforward of D extended to integer degrees by zero. There exists a degree-lowering family of module-sheaf maps on L whose nullHomotopicMap' boundary has, in every natural degree and every full tuple coordinate on every base open, the value identity minus signed stable sorting. Signed stable sorting is the finite permutation sum filtered by cechStableSort of the tuple of down-coordinates [def-pc-alternating-cech-sorting-operators], with the restriction from the tuple product to its permuted product, times the permutation sign. No covering or nonemptiness hypothesis is required.

proof.text: Construct adjacent-degree maps explicitly: take the finite signed junction sum of full tuple projections and restriction natural transformations, assemble by Pi.lift, and compose with e inverse. Naturality follows from functoriality and uniqueness of arrows between opens. Apply hlinear coordinatewise, restriction semilinearity, and product-coordinate injectivity to prove local linearity; PresheafOfModules.homMk gives module-sheaf morphisms. The natural coordinate definition is used, not the degreewise projection existence theorem.

Use the explicit intersection site with opens infimum_k (W0(t k) meet B). Its canonical restriction to the chosen tuple product times B is an isomorphism. Evaluate hd at each tuple coordinate and use cechComplexFunctor_d_pi to identify the differential with the alternating face sum; all compared composites of open maps agree by thinness. The constructed adjacent maps become cechFirstSortingHom on this intersection model.

Apply cechFirstSortingIdentity to these sectionwise cochains. Expand nullHomotopicMap in degree zero separately, where the incoming term vanishes, and in successor degrees as the two adjacent compositions. The preceding coordinate identities identify its boundary with identity minus signed stable sorting. This includes r=0, repeated tuples, and degrees above r without extra hypotheses.

Push the constructed null homotopy forward and extend it using Mathlib mapHomotopy and Homotopy.extend. The homotopy comm equation identifies its boundary with extendMap of the pushed-forward natural boundary. Cancel extendXIso and use injectivity of the intersection restriction isomorphism to recover the exact orderedCechFullCoordinate formula on each inverse-image open.

proof_origin.note: Explicit module-sheaf assembly of the additive first sorting identity; second reading verifies construction, local scalar compatibility, degree-zero boundary, and pushforward/extension transport. DegreewiseProjection supplies only its real natural-coordinate definition.

theorem orderedCech_module_firstSorting_boundary {X' T' : Scheme.{u}} (f' : X' ⟶ T')
    (M : X'.Modules) {r : ℕ} (W₀ : ULift.{u} (Fin r) → X'.Opens)
    (D : CochainComplex X'.Modules ℕ)
    (e : ∀ p : ℕ, (PresheafOfModules.forgetToPresheafModuleCat (op ⊤) isTerminalTop.op).obj
          (D.X p).val ≅
        ((cechComplexFunctor W₀).obj
          ((prod.functor (C := X'.Opens)).op ⋙ Functor.opHom _ _ ⋙
            (Functor.whiskeringRight _ _ _).obj
              M.presheafModuleCat)).X p)
    (hd : ∀ p : ℕ,
        (PresheafOfModules.forgetToPresheafModuleCat (op ⊤) isTerminalTop.op).map
            (D.d p (p + 1)).val ≫ (e (p + 1)).hom =
          (e p).hom ≫ ((cechComplexFunctor W₀).obj
            ((prod.functor (C := X'.Opens)).op ⋙ Functor.opHom _ _ ⋙
              (Functor.whiskeringRight _ _ _).obj
              M.presheafModuleCat)).d p (p + 1))
    (hlinear : ∀ (p : ℕ) (y : Fin (p + 1) → ULift.{u} (Fin r)) (B : X'.Opens),
        let c : Γ(D.X p, B) → Γ(M, (∏ᶜ fun l ↦ W₀ (y l)) ⨯ B) :=
          fun s ↦ ((e p).hom ≫ Pi.π (fun y : Fin (p + 1) → ULift.{u} (Fin r) ↦
            ((prod.functor (C := X'.Opens)).op ⋙ Functor.opHom _ _ ⋙
              (Functor.whiskeringRight _ _ _).obj
                M.presheafModuleCat).obj
                (op (∏ᶜ fun l ↦ W₀ (y l)))) y).app (op B) s
        ∀ (a : Γ(X', B)) (s : Γ(D.X p, B)),
          c (a • s) = X'.presheaf.map (prod.snd :
            (∏ᶜ fun l ↦ W₀ (y l)) ⨯ B ⟶ B).op a • c s) :
    let L := ((((Modules.pushforward f').mapHomologicalComplex _).obj D).extend
      ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat)
    ∃ H : ∀ i j : ℤ, (ComplexShape.up ℤ).Rel j i → (L.X i ⟶ L.X j),
      ∀ (p : ℕ) (B : T'.Opens) (y : Fin (p + 1) → ULift.{u} (Fin r))
        (s : Γ(L.X (p : ℤ), B)),
        orderedCechFullCoordinate f' M W₀ D e p B y
          (((Homotopy.nullHomotopicMap' H).f (p : ℤ)).app B s) =
          orderedCechFullCoordinate f' M W₀ D e p B y s -
          (∑ σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin (p + 1)),
        if cechStableSort (fun l ↦ (y l).down) σ then
          (Equiv.Perm.sign σ : ℤ) •
            M.presheaf.map (prod.map
              (Pi.lift fun l ↦ Pi.π (fun k ↦ W₀ (y k)) (σ l)) (𝟙 _)).op
                (orderedCechFullCoordinate f' M W₀ D e p B (y ∘ σ) s)
        else 0)
